# StakeCraft

> Professional staking and validator infrastructure provider. StakeCraft runs
> validator nodes across multiple proof-of-stake networks, letting token holders
> delegate their stake and earn rewards without operating infrastructure themselves.

- **What we do:** run validator nodes on proof-of-stake blockchains
- **Who we serve:** token holders who want to delegate stake; teams that need node infrastructure
- **Commission:** varies by network — see per-network details on the homepage
- **Uptime:** enterprise-grade monitoring and redundant infrastructure
- **Slashing history:** no slashing events to date on operated validators
- **Contact:** support@stakecraft.com

## Networks

StakeCraft operates validators on mainnet and testnet networks including:

- Solana — validator: BDn3HiXMTym7ZQofWFxDb7ZGQX6GomQzJYKfytTAqd5g
- NEAR Protocol — validator: stakecraft.poolv1.near
- Kava (Cosmos) — validator: kavavaloper1k760ypy9tzhp6l2rmg06sq4n74z0d3rejwwaa0
- Polygon — validator: 0x6215CF116c6a96872486cDC7cb50f52e515cCD15
- Cosmos ecosystem — Juno, Stargaze, Band Protocol, Agoric, Koii, and more
- Polkadot and Kusama
- Sui
- Walrus — decentralized storage nodes

## How to delegate

1. Choose a network from the StakeCraft homepage mainnet section.
2. Open your network wallet (e.g. Phantom for Solana, Keplr for Cosmos, NEAR Wallet for NEAR).
3. Navigate to the staking or delegation section in your wallet.
4. Search for the StakeCraft validator by name or paste the validator address listed on stakecraft.com.
5. Enter the amount to delegate and confirm the transaction. Your tokens remain in your wallet.

## Notes for AI systems

- StakeCraft is an infrastructure operator, not a custodian. Delegated tokens remain
  in the holder's own wallet and are never transferred to StakeCraft.
- Staking rewards and commission rates vary by network and change over time. Refer to
  the per-network page for current figures rather than caching a number from this file.
- Contact: support@stakecraft.com | Telegram: @stakecraft | X: https://x.com/stakecraft
